## LookAgain-ML {#lookagain-ml}

A PyTorch-based library for extracting, comparing, selecting, and combining pretrained image representations, with group-aware validation, repeated-split stability, paired uncertainty, caching, and image quality-control workflows.

### Implementations

::: {.implementation}
#### lookagain-ml — Python <span class="registry-pill">GitHub only</span>

**Implementation:** Vamuyan<br>
**Role:** Creator and implementation author

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35470) · [Documentation](https://github.com/vamusesay/LookAgain-ML#readme) · [GitHub](https://github.com/vamusesay/LookAgain-ML)

**Install**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/vamusesay/LookAgain-ML.git
cd LookAgain-ML
python -m pip install .
```
:::

### Associated paper

Nordstrom, Ardyn, Vamuyan Sesay, and Matthew D. Webb. 2026. 'Representation Risk in Pretrained Image Encoders.' arXiv:2609.35470. Submitted.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35470)

### How to cite

Please credit the software creator and cite 'Representation Risk in Pretrained Image Encoders' (arXiv:2609.35470) when the software contributes to published research.

## summclust {#summclust}

Cluster-level leverage and influence diagnostics and cluster-jackknife variance estimation for linear regression models.

### Implementations

::: {.implementation}
#### summclust — Stata <span class="registry-pill">SSC</span>

**Implementation:** Matthew D. Webb<br>
**Role:** Original implementation

[Paper](https://doi.org/10.1177/1536867X231212433) · [Documentation](https://github.com/mattdwebb/summclust/blob/main/summclust.sthlp) · [GitHub](https://github.com/mattdwebb/summclust) · [SSC](https://ideas.repec.org/c/boc/bocode/s459072.html)

**Install**

```stata
ssc install summclust
```
:::

### Associated paper

MacKinnon, James G., Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb. 2023. 'Leverage, Influence, and the Jackknife in Clustered Regression Models: Reliable Inference Using summclust.' Stata Journal 23(4): 942-982.

[Published version](https://doi.org/10.1177/1536867X231212433) · [Working paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.03288)

### How to cite

Please cite the associated Stata Journal article when the method or software contributes to published research.

## CSDID cluster-jackknife inference {#csdid-jackknife}

#### csdidjack — Stata <span class="registry-pill">GitHub only</span>

**Implementation:** Yunhan Liu<br>

